name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships (PM-USP)
org: Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
description: Flagship Ministry of Education scheme providing direct financial support for college and university students from economically constrained families.
requirements: Top 20th percentile (above 80%) in Class 12 / Higher Secondary board examination.
Enrolled in regular full-time undergraduate degree program in recognized college/university.
Total annual family income strictly below ₹4.5 Lakhs per annum.
Aadhaar-seeded bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via NSP OTR.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
org: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Empowers meritorious female students in engineering and technology with ₹50,000/year to cover tuition fees, computer equipment, and books.
requirements: Female candidate admitted to 1st year technical degree or diploma (or 2nd year via lateral entry).
Enrolled in an AICTE-approved college or university.
Family income not exceeding ₹8 Lakhs per annum (maximum 2 daughters per family).
Valid domicile and verified academic marks on NSP portal.

name: Generation Google Scholarship (APAC)
description: Premier scholarship awarded by Google to women in tech demonstrating technical passion, leadership qualities, and community impact in computer science.
requirements: Enrolled as full-time undergraduate student in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or closely related technical field.
Strong academic performance and demonstrated leadership in student or tech communities.
Submission of technical resume, academic transcripts, and essay prompts on overcoming technical barriers.
Commitment to advancing diversity and underrepresented groups in software engineering.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
org: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Govt. of India
description: DST initiative offering ₹80,000 annually (₹60,000 cash grant + ₹20,000 summer research project mentorship) for students pursuing basic and natural science degrees.
requirements: Top 1% rank in Class 12 board examinations or top ranks in JEE Main / NEET / KVPY.
Enrolled in B.Sc., B.S., or Integrated M.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, Math, Biology, or related sciences.
Age between 17 and 22 years at time of enrolment.
Maintain minimum 60% marks or 7.0 CGPA throughout university tenure.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships
description: One of India’s largest private higher education grants providing up to ₹2,00,000 over the course of the degree plus access to workshops and mentoring.
requirements: Resident Indian citizen admitted full-time to 1st year of any recognized undergraduate degree.
Minimum 60% marks in Class 12 examination.
Household annual income below ₹15 Lakhs (preference below ₹2.5 Lakhs).
Mandatory participation in the online Reliance Foundation aptitude assessment.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
org: AICTE, Ministry of Education (Govt. of India)
description: Government of India scholarship providing ₹50,000 per annum to differently-abled students admitted to AICTE-approved colleges.
requirements: Admitted to 1st year degree or diploma technical course in an AICTE-approved institution.
Candidate disability not less than 40% certified by competent government medical board.
Family income not exceeding ₹8 Lakhs per annum.
Aadhaar-linked bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer.

name: Tata Trusts Higher Education Grant
description: Renowned philanthropic grant helping meritorious students from low-income families offset college tuition fees and educational materials.
requirements: Enrolled in recognized undergraduate or postgraduate degree program in India.
Minimum 65% aggregate or equivalent CGPA in prior academic semester.
Family annual income strictly below ₹4.5 Lakhs per annum.
Official college fee receipts and institutional verification form.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
org: Ministry of Minority Affairs (Govt. of India)
description: Financial assistance for tuition fees and maintenance allowance to students from notified minority communities pursuing higher education.
requirements: Belong to notified minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi).
Minimum 50% marks in the qualifying board or university final examination.
Annual family income from all sources not exceeding ₹2 Lakhs.
Application verified by institute nodal officer through NSP portal.

name: UGC Ishan Uday Special Scholarship for NER
description: Dedicated UGC scholarship disbursing up to ₹7,800 per month for North Eastern Region (NER) students enrolled in recognized college degree courses.
requirements: Valid domicile certificate of one of the 8 North Eastern States (Assam, Arunachal, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura).
Admitted to 1st year of degree program in a recognized university or college.
Family annual income strictly below ₹4.5 Lakhs.
Verified One-Time Registration (OTR) on NSP.

name: Google Summer of Code (GSoC) Open Source Fellowship
description: International development fellowship connecting student developers with open-source organizations, including hands-on mentorship and paid stipends.
requirements: 18 years or older enrolled in post-secondary education or eligible open-source contributor.
Demonstrated programming proficiency in modern languages (Python, C++, Java, Rust, JavaScript, Go).
Submission of structured open-source technical proposal with milestones and deliverable timeline.
Successful completion of 175-hour or 350-hour open-source project sprint under mentor guidance.

name: Prime Minister’s Special Scholarship Scheme (PMSSS)
org: AICTE & Ministry of Education (Govt. of India)
description: Comprehensive scholarship paying full tuition plus ₹1 Lakh annual maintenance for students from UTs of J&K and Ladakh admitted through AICTE counselling.
requirements: Domicile certificate of Jammu & Kashmir or Ladakh.
Passed Class 12 from JKBOSE or CBSE affiliated schools in J&K/Ladakh.
Family annual income below ₹8 Lakhs.
Admission strictly through AICTE centralized counselling.

name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme
org: AICTE, Ministry of Education (Govt. of India)
description: Provides ₹50,000/year to support orphans, wards of armed forces martyrs, and students whose parents were lost to the pandemic pursuing technical degrees.
requirements: Candidate is an orphan, or ward of armed forces/paramilitary martyrs, or lost both parents to Covid-19.
Enrolled in AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma institution.
Family annual income strictly below ₹8 Lakhs.
Supporting certificates attested by competent government district authorities.
